recovery_scope.supersession: the refusal ledger entry is never deleted; a recovery record is appended beside it and the published day carries the acquisition regime label

provenance_difference_disclosure: The file-feed profile 2.0 binds each half-hour window to exact source-object URLs, sha256 digests and byte lengths. BigQuery exposes no per-window object identity, so this profile binds job-level provenance instead: the exact query text hash, the BigQuery job id and creation time, bytes processed, and a table last-modified witness. That weaker binding is why the equivalence requirement and the permanent acquisition-regime label are mandatory, and why a day absent from both the file feed and the mirror stays a disclosed gap.
membership_reproducibility: Document membership is not retained and cannot be reconstructed from this attestation; the mirror table may be re-queried while the provider retains it, and only aggregate counts are persisted.
claim_boundary: A valid attestation reproduces only the registered target-day aggregate shares, channel sums and calibrated final store row from job-level query evidence and per-window counts. It does not prove per-object source identity, retained document membership, public identity, extract or full-record redistribution rights, source truth, precision, causation, forecast validity or production authorization.
